name: Detect Compulsion
body:
Discipline: clairsentience; Level: vitalist 1, psion/wilder 1

MANIFESTING

Display: None (see text)
Manifestation Time: One swift action

EFFECT

Range: 60 feet
Target: 1 creature
Duration: instantaneous
Saving Throw: None; Power Resistance: No
Power Points: 1

DESCRIPTION

You detect if the target creature is under the effects of a compulsion or charm. Affected creatures appear to have an amber aura, though no one but you sees this visual effect.
